$comment: Product backlog. Canonical machine state - automation reads this, not Markdown. Scores assist prioritisation only; the Project Manager, Client and Architect decide scope. A rejected item does not return without new evidence.

items.title: CI proves what deployment ships (v2-unit layer)
items.userProblem: A V2 regression reaches production undetected. The 49 tests covering the application that serves careerscope.tech run in no workflow.
acceptanceCriteria: A v2-unit CI job runs the no-services V2 tests on every push
The job states what it does NOT cover, so it cannot imply full V2 coverage
Proven: breaking a v2 unit test turns the job red
evidence: git grep 'npm test' .github/workflows -> ci.yml:76 and deploy.yml:73, both the ROOT suite only
v2 test script requires --env-file=.env; v2/.env is gitignored
items.securityImpact: none directly; removes a blind spot in the release path
items.architectureImpact: CI topology only; no application change

items.title: Lead table header offset is wrong on Linux WebKit at 768px
items.userProblem: The sticky header is 48px out on Safari at tablet width, so rows sit underneath it.
acceptanceCriteria: Reproduced in the Playwright Linux container, not guessed from Windows
Root cause named; the assertion is not widened
check-ui.mjs green on all three engines in CI
evidence: webkit: sticky offset mismatch at 768px - header 57, expected 105, delta -48.0000
57 = 3.5rem*16+1 and 105 = 6.5rem*16+1: two breakpoints apart, not a settle race
Passes on Windows WebKit (webkit-2359); CI runs Linux WebKit

items.title: Proxy restart strands every service behind a healthy-looking 502
items.userProblem: The site can be entirely down while every container reports healthy.
acceptanceCriteria: A Caddy crash recovers without operator action, or is detected and alerted
Proven by killing Caddy and observing the result
evidence: restart-stack.sh is operator recovery, not self-healing

items.title: Release publishes a stale version string when a version file is added
items.userProblem: Published Pages can claim a version that was never released.
acceptanceCriteria: The publish list is derived from versionFiles(), not duplicated
A test asserts every versionFiles key is staged

items.title: Retire the V1 application layer
items.userProblem: Two application layers to maintain; only one ships.
acceptanceCriteria: apps/api and apps/web removed with CI green
evidence: Dockerfile copies only apps/api/package.json, for workspace resolution
scripts/export-mobile.mjs and export-admin.mjs read the V1 SQLite database
React is 19.2.8 in both trees - no dependency conflict keeps them apart

items.title: Frontend route architecture, auth boundary and shared shell
items.userProblem: No deep links, no per-page loading or error states, no auth boundary. One 830-line page.tsx fakes navigation with a view variable.
evidence: 1 page.tsx in v2; UX/UI recorded at 15%
